value.rationale: The canonical block-graph family exhibits the strong discrepancy between an observation count that forgets all block sizes and a complete multiplicity spectrum that reconstructs them. The proof gives a natural exact information-loss invariant, a unique maximum and a sharp runner-up classification, and an explicit constructive inverse algorithm for arbitrary heterogeneous block sizes. These precise graph parameters matter for quantifying ambiguity of rough observations; no general downstream result is asserted.
